provenance.how_captured: rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --marker-trace, windowed to a roctx range around the measured generate; warmup outside; MI355X gfx950, ROCm 7.2.2, single dedicated GPU
provenance.launch_counts: prefill 4,902 launches over 2 geometries (43 each of two shapes); decode 11,008 launches = 43 layers x 256 tokens plus 43 of a second shape
provenance.grid_note: rocprofv3 Grid_Size is work-items. Launch is (num_tokens, num_heads) programs at 256 threads; observed work-item grids (139008,64,1) and (47104,64,1) at prefill, (256,64,1) and (4096,64,1) at decode, giving 543 / 184 / 1 / 16 tokens.
